# Luigi

> Luigi is an open-source micro frontend framework, part of the NeoNephos
> Foundation (originally created at SAP). The application shell (Luigi Core)
> hosts embedded micro frontends — either as iframes (communicating via
> postMessage) or as Web Components running in the shell's own document.
> Luigi Client is the SDK used by iframe-based micro frontends to talk back
> to the shell. Luigi Container wraps Core as a Web Component
> (`<luigi-container>`, `<luigi-compound-container>`) for embedding without
> a full shell.
>
> Apache-2.0. Node >= 20.19.0 to build.

## Documentation

The canonical, curated index of Luigi documentation is the MkDocs navigation
in the repository. It groups every documentation page into Basics, Luigi Core,
Navigation, Authorization, Luigi Client, Luigi Container, API Reference,
Advanced, and Examples:

- [docs/mkdocs.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SAP/luigi/main/docs/mkdocs.yml) — grouped index of every documentation page.

All documentation pages live as Markdown under `docs/` in the repository.
Fetch individual pages as raw Markdown:

- URL pattern: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SAP/luigi/main/docs/<page>.md`
- Browse on GitHub: <https://github.com/SAP/luigi/tree/main/docs>

The rendered documentation site (HTML only) is at <https://docs.luigi-project.io>.
Prefer the raw Markdown URLs above when fetching content programmatically.
